title: Granny Cake
description: This granny cake recipe topped with a sweet evaporated milk glaze is easy to make from scratch with canned pineapple and standard cake ingredients.
ingredients: 1 (20 ounce) can crushed pineapple with juice

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Make the cake: Whisk flour, sugar, baking soda, and salt together in a large bowl. Stir in undrained pineapple, eggs, and vanilla until just combined. Pour into an ungreased 9x13-inch baking pan.
Make the topping: Mix brown sugar and walnuts together in a small bowl. Sprinkle over cake batter.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 25 to 35 minutes.

While the cake is baking, make the glaze: Combine butter, sugar, evaporated milk, and vanilla in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until butter melts and sugar dissolves; mixture will be thin.
Remove cake from the oven and immediately pour glaze over the surface. Serve warm or at room temperature.

video.description: This melt-in-your-mouth baked dessert goes perfectly with a cup of coffee in the morning. In this video, Nicole shows you how to make a homemade Granny Cake that incorporates crushed pineapple directly into the cake batter. Topped with chopped walnuts, brown sugar, and a buttery glaze, this vintage cake is just as good as granny used to make.
